notes: Used midpoint of low/high as cost-per-GPU for fleet sizing. Loan assumed to finance H100-class hardware specifically since that's what this cost figure covers -- actual mix (H100/H200/B200) isn't disclosed, flagged as a simplification.

Source states debt-financed builds backed by customer offtake contracts run 'effectively 100%' utilized -- capacity is sold before the GPU is racked. CoreWeave's own facility disclosure confirms this structure ('customer contracts supporting the new debt'). Used 95%, not literal 100%, as a conservative haircut for maintenance/transition downtime -- a judgment call, not itself sourced to a specific number.
